evidence.summary: In 2018 SASTIND and the Ministry of Education added Xiamen University, with seven other universities, to the universities they co-build in 2016–2020, to support defence-specialty disciplines, defence research bases and teams, and training for the defence industry.

CASI lists a satellite branch at Xiamen University (its 6th Research Office) of the national defence science and technology key laboratory for precision guidance and automatic target recognition headquartered at the PLA’s National University of Defense Technology, and reports that the Xiamen branch developed chips for the Beidou satellite system.
